initialExam.title: APPSC Group 1 Services 2026
initialExam.description: APPSC Group 1 exam for senior administrative posts in Andhra Pradesh state government.
initialExam.syllabus: Prelims: GS + Mental Ability. Mains: GS-I to III, AP History & Culture, Economy & Development, Telugu/Urdu. Interview.
initialExam.examPattern: Prelims: 150Q, 150 marks. Mains: 6 papers, 900 marks. Interview: 75 marks.
initialExam.jobRole: Deputy Collector, DSP, Commercial Tax Officer, and AP state civil services
initialExam.careerGrowth: Deputy Collector → Joint Collector → Collector → Secretary.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit psc.ap.gov.in 2. Register (OTPR) 3. Fill form 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Government accommodation, Vehicle, Medical, Pension
